phaseName: Foundation: Scaffold, Liquid Glass, Shell Skeleton
goal: Stand up the Vite+React+TS project, the Liquid Glass design system, and a working desktop shell skeleton (desktop, transparent menu bar, dock, window manager, app registry) that every later phase consumes.
summary: Phase 1 complete: Foundation scaffold, Liquid Glass design system, and desktop shell skeleton all built and verified. Step 1: Vite+React+TS project scaffolded with Vitest, Playwright, axe; `npm run build` emits static dist/index.html. Step 2: Liquid Glass design system — tokens.css (CSS custom properties with [data-theme=dark] overrides), glass.css (backdrop-filter utility classes), GlassPanel/GlassToolbar/GlassSidebar components, useTheme hook (toggles document [data-theme], persists to localStorage); 8 unit tests pass. Step 3: Desktop shell — auto-discovering AppRegistry (import.meta.glob), useWindows hook (open/close/minimize/focus/move/resize with z-order), Desktop wallpaper, transparent glass MenuBar with Apple/File menus + theme toggle + clock, floating glass Dock with running indicators, draggable WindowManager with traffic-light controls, Shell composition; placeholder About app registered. 4 Playwright E2E tests pass (render+backdrop-filter assertion, dock launch, theme toggle, minimize/close window). Full verification: `npx vitest run` → 8 passed; `npx playwright test shell-skeleton` → 4 passed; `npm run build` → exit 0.
stepSummaries:
1. Scaffold Vite React-TS project; add Vitest, @playwright/test, @axe-core/playwright. Files: package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, tsconfig.node.json, index.html, src/main.tsx, src/App.tsx, playwright.config.ts. [verified]
  2. Liquid Glass design system. Files: src/styles/tokens.css (color/blur/radius vars; [data-theme=dark] overrides), src/styles/glass.css (backdrop-filter utilities), src/components/glass/GlassPanel.tsx, GlassToolbar.tsx, GlassSidebar.tsx, src/hooks/useTheme.ts (toggles document [data-theme]); src/glass.test.tsx. [verified]
  3. Desktop shell + window manager. Files: src/system/Desktop.tsx (wallpaper), src/system/MenuBar.tsx (transparent bar), src/system/Dock.tsx, src/system/WindowManager.tsx + src/system/useWindows.ts (open/close/minimize/focus/z-order), src/system/AppRegistry.ts (auto-discover via per-app manifest), src/system/Shell.tsx; register a placeholder 'About' app. Add src/e2e/shell-skeleton.spec.ts. [verified]

reviewerRationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.

gateVerdicts.evidence: Step 1 verify: `npm run build` exit 0; Step 2 verify: `npx vitest run src/glass.test.tsx` → 8 passed; Step 3 verify: `npx playwright test shell-skeleton` → 4 passed. All real test/build commands, no proxies.
gateVerdicts.rationale: All three steps used real verification: Step 1 production build, Step 2 Vitest unit tests exercising component rendering + hook state/effects, Step 3 Playwright E2E launching a browser against the built app. No proxy or sentinel checks.

gateVerdicts.evidence: AppRegistry auto-discovery, useWindows hook, Liquid Glass tokens, and shell components (MenuBar/Dock/WindowManager/Shell) are all in place and exercised by the passing E2E suite. About app launches, windows minimize/close, theme toggles.
gateVerdicts.rationale: Phase goal was to stand up the Vite+React+TS project, Liquid Glass design system, and working desktop shell skeleton consumed by later phases — all three are delivered. The shell renders desktop + transparent glass menu bar + dock + window manager; the About app launches from dock; theme toggles system-wide; windows can be opened/minimized/closed.

gateVerdicts.evidence: Spotlight/Launchpad/Control Center/Spaces explicitly deferred to Phase 2 per the scoped plan; 8 core apps deferred to Phases 3-5.
gateVerdicts.rationale: Nothing deferred beyond what the plan explicitly assigns to later phases. Spotlight, Launchpad, Control Center, and Spaces are Phase 2 work by design, not unexpected deferrals. The full menu system and shared desktop-state store are also Phase 2. No unplanned gaps in Phase 1's scope.
